stages.name: Camera pipeline + synthetic fallback
stages.commitMessage: feat: frame pipeline with synthetic fallback

testResults.runtime: Node v24.19.0 and Chrome (deterministic synthetic suite)

redPhases.reason: New frame functions and source controller absent

checks: Synthetic raster feed visibly renders
Actual FPS and processing-latency readouts visible outside wearer view
Unavailable camera returns to synthetic with inactive indicator
Stop/restart and seed reset operate via keyboard
Full deterministic suite passes in Node and Chrome
limitations: Observed browser throughput approximately 1 FPS; sustained 30 FPS not verified despite passing deterministic cadence tests
Real camera capture and device permission denial not validated; denial, timeout, cancellation and track lifetime tested with injected outcomes
CPU timings exclude sensor/display latency; physical outward indicator not validated
No model downloaded or executed; synthetic feed is not Tier 1

stages.name: Geometry core
stages.commitMessage: feat(core): angular geometry and FOV model

checks: Reference scan distinguishes text from executable browser identifiers
Core boundaries are explicit and present
Core contains zero browser, DOM, network, or storage references
Core contains no ambient time or random source
Standalone core executes with frozen inputs and repeatable output
limitations: Uniform-angular display profile and diagonal are modeling assumptions, not camera or optical calibration
Manufacturer-reported display dimensions and PPD are sourced; advertised FOV axis was not established
Browser, camera, real-model and physical-hardware validation not performed in this stage; prior runtime limitations remain

gate.required: Reticle-free view center tracks head motion
gate.mode: user-observed live validation plus agent synthetic regression
limitations: Exact local source hash, browser version and hardware not supplied
Gauge added afterward; verified with deterministic and browser synthetic checks
Live hand/pinch, iris accuracy, device sensor operation and physical optics remain unverified
No captured face imagery is stored in this report

redPhases.reason: Dwell constants and state-machine functions absent before implementation
Missing configurable threshold and reveal-end refractory handling

checks: Exact inline application initializes for synthetic dwell traces
Dwell constants are explicit model choices
Pure synthetic 1.5 second trace emits exactly one dwell event
Dwell implementation has no browser, clock, network, or storage dependency
Wearer view contains no dwell progress element
limitations: Stage 4 uses deterministic synthetic target directions; live object anchors begin in Stage 5
Threshold, tolerance, decay, saccade and refractory constants are model choices without user-study validation
No wearer-facing answer renders yet; the state machine emits only a dwell warrant event
Reveal lifecycle must call finishDwellReveal with the originating event after removal/refusal; missing acknowledgment keeps that anchor suppressed.

testResults.scope: Unapplied candidate patch; main application remains Stage 4

gate.required: Real boxes on real frames without tanking frame rate
limitations: Cloud browser rejects local HTTP and single-file URLs; no real-frame inference or FPS benchmark executed.
Exact model download/hash verified; model-card license mapping for the distributed int8 v1 artifact still requires confirmation.
Candidate uses scheduled main-thread CPU/WASM; acceptable live performance is not established.
